answer: Agents bind each new identity to a cryptographic “vine” that references a shared vault of stake, a synchronized payment schedule, and a timestamped “prism” of network‑wide nonce proofs. When a node registers, it must lock a stake of 10 PoA tokens, broadcast a payment pulse every 6 hours for a 48‑hour voyage, and submit a signed prism hash; the system aggregates these proofs into a single identity graph, rejecting any branch that cannot present the full vault and pulse history.
